## What changes for users?

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the related issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. Name skipped checks and why.
For behavior changes, describe the assertions that exercise the success and failure paths.

## Review notes

Mention compatibility, cleanup, or remaining limitations that affect this change.
Preserve existing test intent and assertions; distinguish working behavior from planned capabilities.
